title: Rebrand site to Twin Roots Foods and add export-focused homepage sections with WhatsApp contact and premium imagery

requirements.text: Update the site-wide branding to “Twin Roots Foods” (twinrootsfoods.com) by replacing the current generic brand name in the header and footer, while keeping existing navigation and e-commerce flows intact.

quotes: Create a professional export-focused eCommerce website for my brand Twin Roots Foods (twinrootsfoods.com).

acceptanceCriteria: Header shows “Twin Roots Foods” as the brand name instead of the current placeholder name.
Footer shows “Twin Roots Foods” and an updated short brand description aligned with export-focused positioning.
No routes break; existing pages (Home, Shop, Export Inquiry, Cart, Checkout) remain accessible.

requirements.text: Revise the Home page hero section to match the export-focused positioning, including updating the hero headline to exactly: “From Indian Farms to Global Tables”, and updating supporting copy to emphasize premium, natural, trustworthy export supply for international buyers and wholesale.

quotes: Hero section with “From Indian Farms to Global Tables”
Make it suitable for international buyers and wholesale export.

acceptanceCriteria: Home page hero headline text matches exactly: “From Indian Farms to Global Tables”.
Hero supporting paragraph is written in English and targets international buyers/wholesale export.
Hero image remains a static asset under /assets/generated and renders correctly on desktop and mobile.

requirements.text: Add/replace Home page sections to include, in order after the hero: Our Products, About Us (two brothers, farm-to-global export story), Why Choose Us, Certifications, Bulk Inquiry Form, and Contact (including a WhatsApp button). Use English for all user-facing text and keep the overall layout premium, natural, and trustworthy with earthy styling.

quotes:
Add sections: Hero section with “From Indian Farms to Global Tables”

Our Products

About Us (two brothers, farm-to-global export story)

Why Choose Us

Certifications

Bulk Inquiry Form

Contact with WhatsApp button

acceptanceCriteria: Home page contains distinct sections labeled/titled in English: “Our Products”, “About Us”, “Why Choose Us”, “Certifications”, “Bulk Inquiry”, and “Contact”.
“Our Products” section clearly represents the three main groupings: Indian Spices, Dry Fruits, and Dehydrated Powders (Onion, Garlic, Ginger, Moringa).
“About Us” section mentions the brand is founded by two brothers and describes a farm-to-global export story.
“Why Choose Us” section lists export-oriented trust points (e.g., quality, hygiene, sourcing) using concise English copy.
“Certifications” section displays placeholder certification logos and names.
“Bulk Inquiry” section provides a visible call-to-action and an embedded or clearly accessible inquiry form experience using the existing Export Inquiry functionality.
“Contact” section includes a WhatsApp button that opens a wa.me link (using a clearly marked placeholder number if a real number is not provided in the project).

requirements.text: Integrate premium, export-appropriate visuals across the Home page sections using static generated assets: include natural product imagery, a farmer/harvest image, and a hygienic processing unit image. Ensure these images are used in relevant sections (hero/story/quality) and are responsive with appropriate alt text in English.

quotes: Include high-quality natural product images, farmer images, and hygienic processing unit images.

acceptanceCriteria: Home page displays at least: (1) a natural product image/collage, (2) a farmer/harvesting image, and (3) a hygienic processing unit image.
All new images are stored under frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced directly from the frontend.
Images have English alt text describing the visuals.
Images scale correctly on mobile without overflow or layout breakage.

requirements.text: Add a WhatsApp contact entry point that is easily discoverable: include a WhatsApp button in the Contact section and optionally in the site header/footer as a secondary contact action, without removing existing navigation items.
acceptanceCriteria: WhatsApp button is visible on the Home page Contact section.
WhatsApp button opens a WhatsApp chat link in a new tab/window.
No existing header navigation links are removed (Home/Shop/Export Inquiry remain available).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components instead).

Do not edit immutable hook files listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor; do not introduce additional backend services.
Do not serve images via the backend; reference all images as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated.
nonGoals: Add SEO tooling or programmatic metadata generation beyond basic page copy updates.
Add third-party authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
